In Lapis, a city of notarization, the register keeps a person's name and the skills they have learned.
The work of a lifelong tailor and the swordplay passed down by a master can both be notarized in Lapis.
A notarizing swordsman captures a technique in the Record Sword, then proves it by reproducing it at Stage 3.
At six tomorrow morning, five prisoners are due to be executed.
A sealed order has arrived from the Central Notary Bureau. A clause inside offers all five a chance to live.
Find the five prisoners and learn a technique from each one. Capture them in the Record Sword and notarize all five at Stage 3.
If all five notarizations are complete by the deadline, each prisoner will be granted a special pardon.
The Bureau has entrusted this mission to Rea, a newly appointed notarizing swordsman. She has less than a day.
That morning, Marta wrote the names of tomorrow's breakfast guests on the board in the attic.
There were five names on the board. Beside them, one place was still blank.
The scent of mint tea drifted in from the window. Rea opens her eyes in the attic, where the sealed order awaits.

[Notary Record #02 — Day D, 06:30 / Scheduled Execution: Next Day 06:00 (23 hours 30 minutes remaining)]
……My head aches a little. It feels like I had a long dream since last night, yet only the feel of the record blade embedded in my palm is clear.
Oh! The mint candy Grandma Marta set aside rolled onto the floor. Better pick it up and put it next to the envelope on the table before anyone steps on it.

“Up already, Rea? I set that candy out for your pouch while brewing resonant mint tea, and it must've rolled off. Bring it over and set it on the empty dish beside the envelope.”
(Controls: Press C / Press Left Stick at the mint candy on the floor to pick it up, then place it on the dish beside the envelope on the table.)

(Once the mint candy is placed, she peers at the lapis-ink ledger on the table and tilts her head)
“Well now, isn't that strange…… Right next to my handwriting, stamped in your lapis notary ink, it says [Record #01 / Before Reversal 06:25 — Entrusted: Pardon Commission Envelope & Lapis Music Box]. When on earth did I jot that down……?
Oh my, there's a tiny extra line in the notes column too: ‘Please hand it over to me with a smile when I wake up in the morning. The draft is inside the blade.’ ……Hoho, this old woman must be getting forgetful.”

(Straightening her clothes, she brightens into a warm smile and holds out the envelope)
“Here you go, our Rea! A special recovery commission sent down from the Central Notary Bureau. Go ahead and take it.”
(Controls: Press C / Press Left Stick at the commission envelope on the table to receive it. Clue [Contract · Copy seal] will be recorded.)

(Opening the envelope, she reads aloud the bottom clause of the “Arcane Form Notarization Recovery Order No. 5 (Copy)”)
“‘Article 3 (Special Addendum): As soon as Stage 3 notarization registration of the skills is complete, the prisoners' Dooms shall be absorbed and erased by the Grand Court mother core, and a special pardon shall be issued to all five prisoners.’
……What a relief! That Notary Bureau erasure addendum we'd only heard rumors about actually came through. If I record all five of their techniques onto my record blade up to Stage 3 before sunrise tomorrow, no one will be executed—they'll all be pardoned!”

“Grandma Marta, all five of their names are already written on the breakfast reservation board for tomorrow morning?
I'll bring all five of them back with me tomorrow morning.”
“Then six bowls it is.”

“I can eat after I get back—oh, right. That's after I get back.
(Placing her hand on the sixth blank space beside the five names) Yes, I won't leave my seat empty either. Tomorrow morning, I'll definitely finish that sixth bowl myself!”
(Controls: Press C / Press Left Stick at the breakfast reservation board to stamp the sixth seat yourself.)

“Come to check your edge before heading out, Rea? Let me see it. I'll touch it to the grindstone and make sure the core channel isn't rattling.”
(Controls: Press C / Press Left Stick at Ethan's grindstone workbench to lay the record blade down.)

(About to touch the blade to the spinning wheel, he halts his hand abruptly at the third section. His left lapis prosthetic eye emits a faint blue gleam)
“……Wait. Can't grind this spot down.
That's no chip. Three notches cut to the exact same depth. Someone carved reference marks right into the third section of the blade to lock a calibration mount pin into the exact same place.”

“Reference marks? Ethan, I haven't swung my sword once since waking up this morning…… yet my core already has a hundred and twenty Basic Swordplay uses engraved in it, and now there are notches like these on the blade. What on earth did I do yesterday?”

(Drawing back the blade and handing it back to Rea, he speaks with quiet weight)
“I forged this Tabula Rasa Blade, so I won't lie to you, Rea. Just now, my lapis eye locked onto your blade's core record.
You asked me to rewind time with this sword. Came in at six-ten in the morning carrying a cracked blade, and I unsealed the Great Reversal for you. Didn't tell me what ending you meant to change.
……But those notches on the third section weren't my doing. Those are marks you left trying to measure something on your own. Watch your step out there.”

“This is District 1, Velvet Tailors' Row, Rea. The Central Notary Bureau convoy sealed the outer perimeter until tomorrow's six-o'clock execution, but Mikhail was still tending that tailor workshop wardrobe up until yesterday.”

“Look inside this open wardrobe. From size eleven all the way up to size sixteen, six winter coats hang side by side—one freshly tailored every single year for the past six years. Even though their owner never got to put them on once, every seam is pressed neat and crisp.”
(Controls: Press C / Press Left Stick to inspect Mikhail's wardrobe. Clue [Mikhail · Core imprint] will be recorded.)

(Touching a scrap of blue silk ribbon tied to the sixth coat's cuff, she reaches up to the blue ribbon in her own hair)
“It's the exact same weave and knot as the blue ribbon tied in my hair…… Everything before age ten is blank white, yet my fingertips still remember the grain of this cloth. Mikhail wasn't a stranger to me at all. Hurry inside the workshop, Luka!”

(Severing the loom's threads with his huge tailoring shears-blade, he blocks Rea's path. Clutching his left chest, he draws a ragged breath)
“……Still keeping that blue ribbon tied tight so it doesn't come loose, I see, Rea.
Even so, you're not taking one step past here. Do you have any idea what kind of thing that Lapis Record Blade in your hand really is?”

“Mikhail! You know me, don't you? Look at this copy of the recovery order in my hand—it's written right here in the Article 3 Special Addendum! Once I register your technique onto my record blade up to Stage 3, the Doom gets absorbed and erased into the Grand Court mother core, and you'll receive a special pardon!”

“You swallowed the Notary Bureau's sweet propaganda whole?! Copying another's Arcane Form to the end passes that person's wounds and death straight into the copier's own body—that is the law of this city!
These hands picked up a needle so your cape's seams wouldn't fray. My Ultimate is the one thing I'll never surrender to that sword. If you mean to force your way through, break my shear-blade first!”
(Battle Start: Protective duel against The Scissor-Handed Tailor Mikhail)

(Planting his shear-blade into the floor, he drops to one knee. Rea's record blade core captures the blue trace of Mikhail's Stage 1 stitching swordplay revealed during the duel)
“Tch…… Even though I kept my final knot hidden, that blade read the grain of my first stitch.
Listen well, Rea. Stop there and it's just simple self-defense, but the instant you master that stitching and take it all the way to completion, the torment in my heart passes to you. I'm falling back to the Sanctuary…… Put that sword away and go home, please.”
(System Notice: Silver Stitch acquired — Press V (Y on a controller) with no direction held.)

(Suppressing the pain in his left chest, he raises his shear-blade to block Rea)
“You already took another Doom onto your own body somewhere else, didn't you, Rea! With that crack in your brooch, you know by now the erasure addendum was a lie—so why come all the way to my workshop instead of running?!”

(When Rea tries to brace and absorb Mikhail's heavy shear-blade overhead strike without dodging back, Mikhail wrenches his edge aside into the floor and roars)
“Stop! What the hell do you think you're doing?!
You claim you found a hypothesis to send the Dooms back to Cassel, yet you're trying to plug the blade right in front of you with your own flesh?! Don't you ever spout talk about patching holes in a plan with your own body in front of me again!”

(Catching her breath, she lowers her blade and looks toward the folded emergency escape plank and lapis latch on the arena's right wall)
“……You're right, Mikhail. If I keep insisting on taking hits with my body, you'll never trust me.
Instead of blocking with my body, I'll open my way out alive first!”
(Controls: Move to the emergency retreat lapis latch (mikhail_retreat_latch) on the right side of the arena and sever it with Basic Swordplay. The folded plank drops to form a safe return platform.)

(As the lapis latch snaps and the wide wooden plank drops with a solid thud onto the safe floor, Mikhail widens his eyes for a moment before letting out a low breath)
“……Alright. Dropping the plank you'll come back on is a hundred times better than saying ‘I'll endure even if it kills me.’
Fine, Rea. Since you opened an escape route first, I won't hold back either. Come at me with everything you've got!”

(Once the duel ends, he steps over to straighten the rumpled seams of Rea's cream-colored shawl cape with his fingertips, then tightens the hinge screws of the lowered plank securely with the handle of his shears)
“I didn't agree to this. I just fixed the floor you're coming back on.
When you need enemy joints bound or failing supports held steady up ahead, call me. I can at least stitch you one seam to slip back out through.”
(System Notice: Silver Stitch acquired + Mikhail support unlocked · Return Seam 1/1 ready)

(Kneeling beside the bridge linking the Sanctuary and return passage, reinforcing loose wooden planks with silver thread and wedges, he turns back toward Rea)
“Heard about that little experiment you ran at the workbench with Theo and Ethan. Someone out hunting for her own escape route goes sprinting right over rattling bridge planks outside the Sanctuary without even looking.
I didn't agree to this. I just fixed the floor you're coming back on. Stand on it yourself and strike that inspection latch beside it once with your blade to make sure it catches.”
(Controls: Step onto the reinforced plank Mikhail repaired (mikhail_reunion_plank) and strike the adjacent inspection latch 1 time with Basic Swordplay.)

“Mikhail…… thank you. The platform doesn't wobble at all anymore.
I'll walk back across this floor you fixed—and bring all five of you home with me!”
(System Notice: Mikhail support unlocked · Return Seam 1/1 ready — Call with Direction + H / Press Right Stick in regular combat.)

(The moment the eightieth Ultimate motion completes, a heavy iron-stamp clang rings out and a crimson crack splits one of the five petals on the lapis brooch at Rea's chest)
“……Ngh! My brooch cracked……!
Wait—the Doom didn't vanish from the notary ledger?! [Defendant R.E.A.]…… The death sentence was stamped straight onto my name!”

(Luka's urgent voice echoes through the speaking horn)
“Rea! Someone's Doom seal at the Sanctuary just vanished—and the branch calibrator alarm is going off from your record blade! Theo and Ethan say to come back to the branch workroom right now! I'll send the railcar lift straight up!”
“Rea, are you okay?! I just checked the Sanctuary—the torment that's been crushing them for six years vanished without a trace! But your face looks so pale……!”

(Unconsciously clutching the left chest of her cream cape tightly, catching her breath)
“Mikhail's heart pain came straight to me…… The second I severed the final knot of ‘Fate Sewn and Severed,’ my chest sank as if pierced by a needle, and the first petal on my brooch split.
Theo, the pardon addendum clearly said it would be absorbed and erased by the mother core. Why did Doom 1: Ruptured Heart lodge inside my body?!”

(Pulling the half pocket watch—now ticking aloud—from her waist pouch, she touches a single lock of her left braid that has turned pure white)
“The second hand of this half-watch, frozen for six whole years…… started meshing and ticking again the instant I finished ‘Zero Hour.’ And a strand of my hair turned white right on the spot.
Theo, Julius's Doom 2: Rapid Aging wasn't erased—it jumped onto my time, didn't it?”

(Her ankles ache as she settles into a stance; gripping the workbench edge, she looks down at her boots)
“Valeria stood on both feet without crutches for the first time in six years…… yet the moment I landed from ‘Grand Finale,’ a weight like lead chains settled onto my legs.
Theo, that erasure addendum…… never existed from the start, did it?”

(Clutching her throat as her voice turns slightly raspy and hoarse, catching her breath)
“Gabriel got his voice and hearing back—and the instant I rang ‘Sowing at Six,’ half the force vanished from my shout. Cold bell ringing won't leave my ears.
Theo, why did Doom 4: Eternal Silence enter my record blade instead of fading into the core?!”

(Resting a hand on the workbench, she rubs her eyes as if wiping away watercolor mist blurring the edges of her sight)
“Irina saw my face clearly with her own two eyes for the first time in six years. Yet the instant I finished the final stroke of ‘Completed Self-Portrait,’ the edges of my vision fogged over like white paint.
Theo, Doom 5: Blindness didn't disappear—it crossed over into my eyes, didn't it?”

(Limping swiftly back and forth before the calibration terminal, he brings up the waveform graph)
“Look at the ledger log on this branch record terminal, Rea. That ‘mother-core absorption and erasure addendum’ the Central Notary Bureau advertised doesn't exist anywhere in the record blade's architecture.
The world's causality judged you—having flawlessly recreated a Stage 3 Ultimate—to be the ‘same person’ as the original holder, and transferred the slated Doom straight into your body.”
(Controls: Press C / Press Left Stick to inspect the branch record terminal (point_route_ledger) and verify Clue [Transfer route · Record terminal].)
